Karthik,

Thanks — we received the MAP and reviewed the milestones. We can do the integration smoke on Thu 3/19 morning (10:00 PT) but wanted to flag a priority item: during sandbox validation we observed intermittent tokenization-related latency spikes (~2-3s extra per request) that cause our batch job SLA to miss the heavy-window SLO. This is blocking our ability to validate the baseline.

Given the impact to our evaluation timeline, Finova is formally requesting a temporary SLA exception and priority support for the evaluation window (24/7 on-call for 3 days around the smoke tests). Our procurement contact Tom (cc’d) will coordinate any paperwork.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- A short-term SLA amendment (covering 3/19–3/21)
- A named on-call engineer + escalation contact
- A one-hour post-test readout with your exec sponsor (preferably Fri 3/20)

Thanks,
Alicia

Alicia/Monica,

I’m on the case for the smoke tests. Initial findings from the sandbox logs: we see occasional KV-cache misses on longer prompts and one routing path that falls back to a quantized variant with higher per-token latency under burst. Immediate mitigations I’m implementing now:

- Force consistent routing to the low-latency variant for your test keys (config change: route_policy=prefer_low_latency; applied 2026-03-19 06:30 PT)
- Enable extended tracing for the failing request IDs (retention 72h)
- Increase worker concurrency for your sandbox pool during test window (3/19 09:00–3/19 13:00 PT)

ETA for full profile and remediation plan: 4 hours from now. Named escalation contact while I’m off-shift is Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@redwood.ai). I’ll post the detailed timeline in the Slack channel.

Jordan Blake
Principal Support Engineer | Redwood Inference

Alicia/Tom — quick executive update following the smoke tests this morning: 

- What happened: During the 10:00 test window we observed the latency spikes Alicia noted. Jordan applied a routing policy to prefer the low-latency variant and increased pool concurrency; traces indicate the 95th pct latency dropped from ~1.8s above baseline to ~120ms within 27 minutes of the mitigation.
- What we did: Applied config change (route_policy=prefer_low_latency), enabled extended tracing, increased worker concurrency. We captured all failing request IDs and logs; Jordan will share the artifact in the Slack channel.
- Next steps:
  * Finalize the temporary SLA amendment in DocuSign (I’ve initiated: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-REDWOOD-SLA-AMP). Tom/Procurement, please review the SLA-exception-request.pdf and sign.
  * Friday 3/20 10:00 PT — Exec readout with Rachel to review telemetry and sign-off on moving to the next MAP milestone.
  * Post-readout: finalize commercial redlines (target 3/22) and confirm soft launch readiness checklist (target 3/25).

Please reply if we should expand the monitoring window or if there are additional test cases you want prioritized. We’ll be in the Slack channel during the 3/19–3/21 window and Rachel will be on the Friday readout.

Appreciate the partnership — we want to make sure the evaluation is unblocked and you have full visibility into the fixes.

Best,
